notes: Evoko was acquired by Biamp; the product is now marketed as "Biamp Evoko Liso Room Manager" (see biamp.com/products/product-families/evoko/evoko-liso), but the datasheet used here is the original Evoko manufacturer spec sheet (evoko.se branding, article number ERM2001), cross-verified against current Biamp Cornerstone support docs and a Full Compass Systems retail spec table. The device also has built-in Wi-Fi (802.11 a/b/g/n) and a 13.56MHz RFID/NFC contactless reader for badge check-in — neither is a physical cable port, so both are omitted from the ports list. No USB, HDMI, or audio ports exist; this is a room-scheduling touch panel, not a video/audio signal device. Desktop/wall-mount unit (200 x 200 x 25 mm, 1.3 kg) — rackUnits omitted as not rack-mountable. PoE grade assumed eth-1g since the RJ45 spec states "10/100/1000 Mbit" (gigabit-capable); actual negotiated PoE link speed depends on switch/cabling.

ports.name: Ethernet (RJ-45)
ports.note: 10/100/1000 Mbit; supports PoE & PoE+ (datasheet cites IEEE 802.3af); can also carry power to the unit

ports.name: DC Power In
ports.note: For the optional 12V AC/DC power adapter accessory (used when not powering via PoE); adapter not included in box by default
